questions.q_en:
Fill in the blanks with an appropriate option:

If 25th January 1963 was Monday, then Wednesday and Friday will fall after ______ and _____ days, respectively after 25th January 1963.
questions.solution_en:
25th January 1963 was Monday.

Option (a) 15th, 25th

If we divide 15 by 7, then the remainder will be 1. Thus, the total number of odd days = 01

So, 15th day after Monday = Monday + 1 day = Tuesday.

If we divide 25 by 7, then the remainder will be 4. Thus, the total number of odd days = 04

So, 25th day after Monday = Monday + 4 days = Friday

So, option (a) is incorrect.

Option (b) 58th, 67th

If we divide 58 by 7, then the remainder will be 2. Thus, the total number of odd days = 02

So, 58th day after Monday = Monday + 2 days= Wednesday.

If we divide 67 by 7, then the remainder will be 4. Thus, the total number of odd days = 04

So, 67th day after Monday = Monday + 4 days = Friday

So, option (b) is correct.

Option (c) 17th, 41st

If we divide 17 by 7, then the remainder will be 3. Thus, the total number of odd days = 03

So, 17th day after Monday = Monday + 3 days= Thursday.

If we divide 41 by 7, then the remainder will be 6. Thus, the total number of odd days = 06

So, 41th day after Monday = Monday + 6 days = Sunday

So, option (c) is incorrect.

questions.q_en: One morning at 8 o'clock, Srinath started walking with his back towards the Sun. Then, he turned towards right and walked straight. Then, he again turned left and walked straight. Finally, he turned towards right. Now which direction is he facing?

One morning at 8 o'clock, Srinath started walking with his back towards the Sun. Then, he turned towards right and walked straight. Then, he again turned left and walked straight. Finally, he turned towards right.

Sun rises in the morning from the east direction. Thus, Srinath started walking in the west direction.

Srinath is facing the North direction.

In this question, two statements are followed by four conclusions given as options. Decide which conclusion is definitely true, based on the given statements.

A < B ≥ C > D

C > E ≥ F = G

Option 2: D < F: D < C > E ≥ F. This is definitely false

Option 3: A < E: A < B ≥ C > E. This is definitely false

Option 4: B > G: B ≥ C > E ≥ F = G. This is definitely true.

So, option 4 is the correct answer.
